summary: ReadControlledV4 composes the existing current /4 cold read, exact expected original/revision/fence check, complete canonical serializer byte comparison through a fresh bounded descriptor and the maintained real cold signature/current-policy verifier under the same FileShare.None owner lock. The real signed zero/selected journeys also use this entry point for their explicit post-replacement rereads and current-policy refusals. It reserves no future revision and supplies no live commit, production enrollment, native/provider or ACK authority. Source citations describe prepared source and assertions; actual compilation/runtime and delivery require their own evidence.
title: Current source authentication retains the supplier owner lock
